review: The hymn is the parousia: 1:1–6 is Rev 1:7 (הִנֵּה בָא עִם־הַעֲנָנִים) with 1 Thess 4:16–17, 2:1–6 is Matt 24:30 with Rev 1:7 (וְרָאֲתָה אוֹתוֹ כָּל־עַיִן) nearly verbatim, 3:1–6 is Acts 17:31 with Rev 6:16, and 4:1–6 is Rev 11:15 with Ps 22:29.

The middle pair of lines changes from הַלְלוּהוּ to רוֹמְמוּהוּ to the vocative אֱלֹהַי and הוֹי מַלְכִּי, following the print's سَبِّحُوهُ / مَجِّدُوهُ / يَا إِلٰهِي / يَا مَلِيكُ; the Hebrew keeps four different addresses rather than one repeated refrain.
2:3 וְתִרְאֵהוּ כָל־עָיִן reproduces Rev 1:7 exactly, with the singular eye of the Greek and the Arabic كُلُّ عَيْنٍ, rather than the smoother 'all eyes'.
